sections.abstract:
This is a 20-week clinical trial in participants with primary hypercholesterolemia or mixed dyslipidemia to demonstrate the effect of MK-0524B compared to MK-0524A + Simvastatin on lipid values.

Posted outcomes: Percentage Change From Baseline in Low-density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C). timeframe=Baseline (Week 4 for Period II; Week 12 for Period III) and after 8 weeks of tre. MK-0524B 1.8g/20mg=-44.6; MK-0524A 2g+Simvastatin 20mg=-46.9; MK-0524B 1.8g/40mg=-48.9
